title: SHARUK shares a new track "Text" (feat. Quintana Mills)
htmlContent:
Canadan-based snger and songwriter SHARUK shares a new track called "Text," featuring Quintana Mills. The sound is packed with major mass appeal, that is matched with incredible melodies that you hope never end. This record is accompanied with great songwriting, that is delivered by the masterful singing tone that gives the exact emotion needed at every turn, that puts this record in a special class of audio work.
